app.name: Volume controls
app.summary: Quieter, mute and louder, each running the Home Assistant action you choose.
app.tile_example: Quieter, mute and louder, across a wide tile or down a tall one
app.key_down_hint: The action of this key, such as media_player.volume_down. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.key_mute_hint: Such as remote.send_command command=MUTE, or media_player.volume_mute is_volume_muted=true. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.key_up_hint: Such as media_player.volume_up. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
